paper.title: Bian Que: An Agentic Framework with Flexible Skill Arrangement for Online System Operations
paper.central_claim: 通过事件到数据/知识的可演化 Skill 映射及统一的人类反馈双通道，改善线上运维覆盖、诊断与效率，并使知识和 Skill 协同进化。

provenance.notes: 派发 model type=sonnet，声明映射 gpt-6.1-sol；未独立探测模型，工具未提供可核验 actual_model/session/receipt，故为 null。未读另一席或其他 attempt；未运行收录代码。

reason: 完整版本及附录已读；非权重技能/知识留存闭环在范围内，证据可判定，但协同增益与广泛迁移仅部分支持。
rationale: 事件数据路由与知识双通道具体；线上反馈开关支持后续覆盖收益，但离线99%含同例专家纠正，不能当独立泛化。缺独立谱系原文、统计及总成本。

evidence.quote: All cases follow the same validate-and-retry loop (up to three iterations) and require no code changes.
evidence.support_explanation: Skill 的 schema/prompt 均可针对反馈更新；验证重试不是独立效用门。

evidence.quote: A daily offline process deduplicates and prunes the knowledge base to resolve accumulated contradictions and prevent unbounded growth; corrections take effect immediately through the short-term case memory and need not wait for this cycle.
evidence.support_explanation: 知识写入、纠错、每日整合及后续读取可重建。
归因区分检索不足、推理错误及知识内容错误，分发给不同可编辑对象。

evidence.quote: We qualitatively observe this compounding effect in deployment; a controlled quantitative measurement is left to future work, as it requires a longer horizon than our current six-month deployment permits.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者未量化两个通道的协同复利，限制中心外推。

evidence.quote:
For each pass@
k
k
evaluation, the Skill directory is reset to a clean seed state before the run, so that Skills from prior evaluation runs do not leak into the current run.
evidence.support_explanation: 评估运行间技能清零，但不证明知识库与104事件解耦。

evidence.quote: we curate 104 real operational events sampled from production logs—44 alerts and 60 inspections—each annotated with a ground-truth diagnosis by senior site reliability engineers (SREs).
evidence.support_explanation: 离线分母与人工诊断真值明确。

evidence.quote: additional correction rounds applied to the still-failing cases.
evidence.support_explanation: 99%是失败同例再纠正后的结果，不是未见任务率。

evidence.quote: disabling knowledge retrieval lowers pass@5 from 94.2% to 86.5%
evidence.support_explanation: 知识关闭控制为知识有效性提供支持，但混合短期/长期/初始手册知识。

evidence.quote: Without feedback, the system steadily loses coverage as production traffic drifts
evidence.support_explanation: 13天反馈关闭对照支持后续留存更新有用，组间匹配、分母与区间未详述。
固定Skill控制支持生成/更新整体价值，未分离单项修改和预算。

evidence.quote: The 75% drop in fired alerts is primarily driven by release interception and proactive inspection
evidence.support_explanation: 线上前后对照为系统部署效果，非单独自演化因果估计。

evidence.quote: The default LLM backbone is Qwen3.5-35B-FP8 deployed on a single NVIDIA Tesla L20 GPU.
evidence.support_explanation: 部署资源明确但未报告纠错、蒸馏、重试总开销。
